title: Data-Driven and Participatory Approaches toward Neuro-Inclusive AI

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review of human-robot interaction research to identify anti-autistic ableism (pathologization, essentialism, power imbalances), qualitative interviews with AI developers regarding neuro-inclusive design, and evaluation of LLMs' ability to accurately classify anti-autistic ableist speech using the novel AUTALIC benchmark dataset.

Analyzing participant demographics in human-robot interaction studies to identify the underrepresentation of women, girls, and gender minorities, thereby evaluating the perpetuation of gender essentialism and the historical masculinization of autism.

Analyzing the age distribution of participants in human-robot interaction studies to identify the underrepresentation of autistic adults and evaluate the infantilization of autistic individuals in technology research.
